If your company work is **100% Azure VDI** (Outlook, Teams, Office, browsers, SQL tools inside the virtual desktop), I'd buy the **Lenovo Chromebook Plus 14**. supporting_websites.snippet:
As of mid-2026, Chromebooks have evolved into versatile, efficient laptops suitable for a broad range of users. TechRadar reviewed over 60 Chromebooks to identify top models in various categories based on extensive testing. The HP Chromebook Plus 15.6-inch stands out as the best overall option, offering solid performance, a bright FHD display, and excellent build quality at a mid-range price. For budget-conscious users, the ASUS Chromebook CX15 delivers decent performance at a low cost, though its battery life is limited. The Samsung Galaxy Chromebook 2 360 is the top 2-in-1 choice featuring a stunning QHD+ display and tablet functionality. For mid-range buyers, the Acer Chromebook Plus 514 strikes a great balance between price and performance with over 8 hours of battery life. Compact users will appreciate the Acer Chromebook Spin 312's travel-friendly size and long battery life, while the Acer Chromebook Plus 516 offers a large 16-inch screen and strong performance for users who prefer more screen space.

The guide also addresses common questions about Chromebooks, emphasizing their strength in cloud-based tasks, affordability, long battery life, and simplicity. Future developments such as "Googlebooks"—a new series of AI-powered laptops—are mentioned, though with limited available details. Overall, TechRadar provides insights for buyers with different needs and budgets, from students to mobile professionals.
